text: {"memo": "Disney delivered strong performance in FY2024, with revenue reaching $91.36\u202fbillion, up from $88.90\u202fbillion in FY2023. Net income more than doubled to $4.97\u202fbillion versus $2.35\u202fbillion a year earlier, reflecting improved profitability. Operating income rose to $15.60\u202fbillion from $12.86\u202fbillion, lifting the operating margin to roughly 17% from about 14.5% in FY2023. Diluted EPS increased to $2.72 per share from $1.29, and operating cash flow strengthened to $13.97\u202fbillion from $9.87\u202fbillion. The company\u2019s cash generation supports its content pipeline and strategic initiatives. Overall, Disney shows robust top\u2011line growth, expanding margins, and solid cash flow, indicating solid fundamentals heading into FY2025. View: Buy on dips with strong cash flow support."}
